trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document) WHERE CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) > 2014 AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 0 AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <> 2 AND p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'] RETURN p.position AS col1, MAX(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)) AS col2
